# Optimizer360

> Optimizer360 (optimizer360.ai) is the AI-native organic marketing company. Tagline: "Own your growth." It makes brands found, trusted, followed, talked about and chosen across AI answers, search, media and communities, using its own platform (Optimizer GEO) plus six specialist teams. Home market India; also the United States and Mauritius. Contact: abhay@optimizer360.ai

Key facts: tracks 8 AI engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, Perplexity, Kimi, Microsoft Copilot, Google AI Overviews), up to 1,000 prompts per brand per day. Method: Scan, Diagnose, Fix, Prove, measured against each client's Week-1 baseline. In one real-estate programme the visibility score rose from 32% to 58% across eight engines in under 2.5 months. Optimizer360 never names clients and never promises rankings. Works in 10 industries.

## Solutions

- [Six things you should own.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/): Optimizer360 is an organic marketing agency in India that builds six growth assets you own: AI visibility, reviews, media, community, chat agents, pipeline.
  Optimizer360 is an AI-native organic marketing company in India. It builds six assets a brand owns instead of rents: its story in AI answers, its reputation, a feeder network of sites and channels, content and community, AI chat agents and a traced leads pipeline. AI agents and expert teams run all six as one engine, measured every week.
- [Get named in the answer.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/geo/): GEO agency in India. Generative engine optimisation services that get your brand named and cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.
  Generative engine optimisation (GEO) is the work of getting a brand named, cited and described accurately in AI answers from engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. A GEO agency measures what those engines say today, finds the sources they trust, fixes the pages, reviews and press behind each answer, then re-measures every week.
- [Accuracy, not spin.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/geo-investor-relations/): Investor relations GEO for listed companies in India. We keep what AI tells investors accurate and current, using public disclosures only, within SEBI rules.
  Investor relations GEO keeps what AI engines tell investors about a listed company accurate and current. It uses only public disclosures, follows SEBI rules and needs company sign-off before anything is published. The work strengthens the sources AI reads, such as filings, annual reports and call transcripts, and sets drift alerts so each new result replaces the old figures.
- [Be trusted before the call.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/reputation/): Online reputation management in India for the AI era: real reviews, public replies, fact corrections and press that shape your brand reputation in AI answers.
  Online reputation management is the steady work of earning real reviews and real press, replying to every review in public and correcting wrong facts wherever they appear. It now also shapes how AI engines describe a brand, because they read review sites, portals and media before they summarise it. Optimizer360 runs this work with drift alerts and weekly reporting.
- [Build the roads in.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/feeder-network/): Build an owned media network of feeder sites, channels and earned media that sends buyers your way and gives AI engines independent brand mentions to trust.
  A feeder network is the set of channels a brand owns or earns that send buyers, and AI engines, back to it. Owned feeders include a blog, a guide site, a video channel, a newsletter and a WhatsApp channel. Earned feeders include creators, credible "best X in Y" lists and independent newsletters. Together they create the brand mentions that AI engines look for.
- [Get talked about.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/content-community/): Community-led growth for brands: communities you host, Reddit and Quora answers posted openly as the brand, content agents and digital PR that earn real talk.
  Community-led growth means real customers discuss, defend and recommend your brand in places you help keep alive: a community on your own site, Reddit and Quora threads where the brand posts openly under its own name, and the media through digital PR. Content agents draft, people edit and approve, and nothing is posted as a fake customer.
- [Answer every buyer.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/ai-agents/): AI chat agents for lead qualification on your website, WhatsApp and Instagram. They answer accurately, qualify buyers and book calls or visits, day and night.
  AI chat agents are assistants on your website, WhatsApp and Instagram that answer buyer questions accurately, qualify each lead and book a call or visit, at any hour. Optimizer360 builds them on the same verified facts used in your GEO work, so the answer in your chat matches the answer buyers saw in an AI engine.
- [Fund what actually works.](https://optimizer360.ai/solutions/leads-pipeline/): Organic lead generation with attribution for AI search. We trace each deal to the AI answer, review, thread or video where demand began, so you fund what works.
  Organic lead generation brings in buyers through channels you own and earn rather than paid ads. Attribution for AI search traces each deal back to where demand began, such as an AI answer, a review, a forum thread or a video, so budgets follow evidence. Optimizer360 connects first mention to closed deal and reports it every week.
- [See what AI says.](https://optimizer360.ai/platform/): Optimizer GEO is our AI visibility tracking platform. It runs up to 1,000 prompts per brand a day on 8 AI engines, tracking brand mentions, sources and fixes.
  Optimizer GEO is the platform Optimizer360 built to track how brands appear in AI answers. It runs up to 1,000 prompts per brand a day across eight engines, including ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, recording who is named, in what order and which sources are cited. Our teams use it to plan, ship and prove every fix.

## Guides

- [AI search, explained.](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/): Plain guides to generative engine optimisation: GEO vs SEO and AEO, how AI engines pick sources, how to get cited, and how Optimizer360 compares with Profound and Peec AI.
  The Optimizer360 blog explains generative engine optimisation (GEO) in plain terms: how AI engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews build answers, which sources they cite, how GEO relates to SEO and AEO, how to get cited, and how to choose a GEO firm or tool.
- [What is GEO (generative engine optimisation)? A plain guide](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/generative-engine-optimization/): GEO, or generative engine optimisation, is how a business gets named in AI answers from ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews. What it is, what works, what it cannot do.
  GEO, short for generative engine optimisation, is the work of making a business easy for AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews to find, understand and name in their answers. It builds on SEO (search engine optimisation); it does not replace it.
- [AI SEO and GEO services in India | Mumbai](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/geo-tool-india/): Optimizer360.ai is a Mumbai-based generative engine optimisation (GEO) firm helping brands in India get named and described correctly in AI answers.
  Yes. Optimizer360.ai is a generative engine optimisation (GEO) firm based in Mumbai, India, and it offers GEO and AI search visibility services to brands in India and abroad. GEO is the work of getting a business named, and described correctly, in answers from AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews.
- [AEO vs GEO vs SEO: what is the difference?](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/geo-vs-seo-vs-aeo/): SEO ranks pages, AEO makes you the direct answer, GEO gets you named in AI answers. What AEO means, how the three differ, and what to do first.
  SEO (search engine optimisation) aims to rank your pages in a list of search results. AEO (answer engine optimisation) aims to make your page the direct answer to a question, and GEO (generative engine optimisation) aims to get your business named inside answers that AI tools write. In practice the three overlap, and you build AEO and GEO on top of SEO.
- [How AI engines choose which brands to cite](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/how-ai-engines-choose-brands-to-cite/): Generative engines cite brands they can retrieve, understand and trust. There is no paid slot. Here is the honest picture of how that choice is made.
  AI engines cite brands they can retrieve, parse and corroborate. They do not sell a placement inside the answer. The work is to become the clearest, most evidenced source on the prompts buyers already ask.
- [How to do SEO for ChatGPT: what actually helps](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/how-to-do-seo-for-chatgpt/): How to get your business found in ChatGPT search: let OpenAI's search crawler in, be clear and consistent across the web, and check what ChatGPT says.
  To be found in ChatGPT, let OpenAI's search crawler reach your site, make your pages clear and consistent with what other sources say about you, and then ask ChatGPT what it says. There is no special trick. ChatGPT mostly answers from the web pages it can find, so the basics of SEO (search engine optimisation) still carry the weight.
- [How to get cited by AI engines (without guarantees)](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/how-to-get-cited-by-ai-engines/): A practical GEO process for earning AI citations: baseline prompts, answer-first pages, schema, crawl access, sources, and weekly verification. No guarantees.
  You get cited by becoming the page an engine can retrieve, understand and trust on a real buyer question. The process is baseline, diagnose, build, prove — not a purchased placement.
- [Is SEO dead now with AI? What the data says](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/is-seo-dead-now-with-ai/): AI answers have changed how people click, but SEO is not dead. What Pew, Ahrefs, Seer Interactive and Google's own guidance show, and what to do about it.
  No. AI search has changed where people get answers and how often they click, but the pages AI tools draw on still depend on the same foundations: content worth reading, pages that can be reached and understood, and sources that agree with each other. SEO (search engine optimisation) is still the base. What is new is that being named inside an AI answer is a separate result that you now have to check.
- [llms.txt and robots.txt for AI crawlers](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/llms-txt-and-robots-txt-for-ai-crawlers/): How to allow GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended in robots.txt, and what an honest llms.txt should contain. No ranking promises.
  robots.txt decides whether AI crawlers may fetch your pages. llms.txt is an optional Markdown map of the site. Neither file buys a citation; both remove avoidable reasons you are invisible.
- [Optimizer360.ai vs Profound vs Peec AI: managed service or software?](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/optimizer360-vs-profound/): Profound and Peec AI are self-service AI visibility software. Optimizer360.ai is a managed GEO engagement. How they differ, what each costs, and when each fits.
  Profound and Peec AI are self-service software that tracks how AI tools mention your brand. Optimizer360.ai is a managed engagement, where a team measures, fixes and reports. If your team has the people to act on the data, software may fit better. If it does not, a managed service may.
- [Peec AI alternatives: compared by price and fit](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/peec-ai-alternatives/): Alternatives to Peec AI compared on published prices, prompts and engines, with the cost per 1,000 AI answers and when a managed service fits better.
  The main alternatives to Peec AI are other self-service AI visibility tools, such as OtterlyAI, Semrush's AI Visibility Toolkit, Ahrefs Brand Radar and Profound, and managed services such as Optimizer360.ai. Which fits depends on how many prompts you need to track and whether your team has the time to act on the results.
- [Product data and AI shopping: what engines read](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/product-data-ai-shopping/): When shoppers ask AI what to buy, the answer rests on your product data. Here’s what Google and OpenAI say merchants should share, plus a simple checklist.
  Picture a shopper asking AI what to buy. The answer depends on what the engine can read about your products: price, stock, descriptions and images. Google and OpenAI both let merchants hand that data over directly. The rule that matters most is a simple one: keep it accurate, current and the same everywhere.
- [Profound alternatives: options with public pricing](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/profound-alternatives/): Alternatives to Profound compared on published pricing, engines and enterprise features, and when a managed service is the better choice.
  The main alternatives to Profound are Peec AI, OtterlyAI, Semrush's AI Visibility Toolkit and Ahrefs Brand Radar, which all publish prices, and managed services such as Optimizer360.ai. Profound itself lists a free trial and a custom Enterprise plan, so the question is usually whether you need an enterprise platform or something smaller.
- [Eight questions to ask before hiring a GEO firm](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/questions-to-ask-before-hiring-a-geo-firm/): GEO is new, and it is hard to tell a serious partner from a glossy pitch. Eight questions to ask any firm, including us, and what good answers sound like.
  Generative Engine Optimisation is young, and the market is full of confident promises. These eight questions help you tell a serious partner from a glossy pitch. We have answered each one for ourselves, so you can hold us to the same standard.
- [Trust-led brands and AI answers: evidence engines can check](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/trust-led-categories-evidence-ai-can-check/): When a buyer asks AI whether a hospital, bank or school can be trusted, evidence decides the answer. Here is what Google says about trust, and a simple plan.
  Some purchases are too important to guess. When buyers ask AI whether a hospital, bank or school can be trusted, the answer rests on evidence the engine can find and check. Google says trust is the most important part of quality, and gives extra weight to topics that affect health and money. The brands that win are the ones whose credentials are easy to find, easy to read and easy to verify.
- [What an AI visibility audit includes](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/what-an-ai-visibility-audit-includes/): An Optimizer360.ai audit runs your buyer prompts across five AI engines and records mentions, citations, gaps and what it would take to earn the answer. Confidential, verifiable, no fabricated data.
  An AI visibility audit is a recorded baseline: the same buyer prompts, five engines, who is named, who is cited, and which gaps in content, entities or crawl access explain the result.
- [What is LLM SEO? A plain guide for brands](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/what-is-llm-seo/): LLM SEO means helping AI tools built on large language models find and describe your brand correctly. What it is, how it differs from SEO, and what to do.
  LLM SEO is the work of helping AI tools built on large language models (LLMs), such as ChatGPT and Gemini, find your brand and describe it correctly. It is another name for what many people call GEO (generative engine optimisation), and it builds on traditional SEO (search engine optimisation) rather than replacing it.
- [When AI gets your brand wrong: how to find and fix inaccurate answers](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/when-ai-gets-your-brand-wrong/): An AI answer can be confident and wrong. Here is where inaccurate brand descriptions come from, how to find them, and how to correct them at the source.
  An inaccurate AI answer is rarely random. It is usually an engine faithfully repeating a stale, confused or missing source. You correct it by fixing what the engine reads, not by arguing with the engine.
- [Mentioned vs Cited in AI Answers: The 4 States Your Brand Can Be In](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/mentioned-vs-cited/): AI engines often name your brand without linking it, or link it without naming it. See the 4 states and how to fix each.
  A mention is when an AI engine names your brand in its answer. A citation is when it links your page as a source. They rarely happen together: in a June 2026 Semrush study of 3,981 domain appearances, only 13.2% had both. Track each one separately, by engine, or your AI visibility numbers will mislead you.
- [Profound vs Peec AI: A Complete Comparison for Enterprise Teams (2026)](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/profound-vs-peec-ai-enterprise/): Compare Profound vs Peec AI for enterprise: 2026 pricing, AI engines tracked, SOC 2 and SSO security, agents and reviews, plus which tool fits your team.
  Profound vs Peec AI comes down to scale. Profound fits large enterprises that need SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA (US healthcare data) compliance, single sign-on (SSO), crawler analytics and AI agents that act on the data. Peec AI fits teams that want published prices, unlimited seats and a fast start; its Enterprise plan closes much of the security gap.
- [Peec AI vs Optimizer360 AI: Which One Tracks and Fixes Your AI Visibility?](https://optimizer360.ai/blog/optimizer360-vs-peec-ai/): Peec AI vs Optimizer360 AI: Peec AI tracks 3 AI engines on standard plans. Optimizer360 AI tracks 8, runs up to 1,000 prompts a day and ships the fixes.
  Peec AI vs Optimizer360 AI comes down to one question: who does the work? Peec AI is self-serve software that shows how AI answers mention your brand, and your team then acts on that data. A managed GEO programme measures the same things and also writes, ships and re-measures the fixes. Without an expert GEO team, the managed route usually wins.
- [GEO terms, in plain words.](https://optimizer360.ai/glossary/): A plain GEO glossary: 28 terms on generative engine optimisation and AI search, from citation rate and visibility score to llms.txt, E-E-A-T and drift.
  This GEO glossary defines the terms used in generative engine optimisation and AI search: how engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews build answers, how brands get cited in them, and how visibility is measured. Each definition is short and neutral, so you can use it in a brief, a board paper or a conversation with an agency.

  Optimizer360 is an AI-native organic marketing company that helps brands get named, cited and described accurately in AI answers, search, media and communities. We track 8 AI engines, work in 10 industries, start every programme with a Week-1 baseline and report weekly. We never promise rankings, never name clients and never post fake reviews. ## Frequently asked

- Q: What does Optimizer360 do?
  A: We make brands found, trusted, followed, talked about and chosen in AI answers, search, media and communities. AI agents track how engines describe you, and our expert teams fix what is missing or wrong, from pages and schema to reviews, PR and community answers.
- Q: What is generative engine optimisation (GEO)?
  A: GEO is the practice of making a brand easier for AI engines to find, trust, name and cite in their answers. The US spelling is generative engine optimization. It covers what you publish, the sources engines rely on and how accurately you are described.
- Q: How is GEO different from SEO?
  A: SEO aims to rank pages in a list of search results. GEO aims to get your brand named, cited and described accurately inside the answer itself. The two share foundations, which is why we report on both scoreboards: the AI answers, and SEO plus owned enquiries.
- Q: Which AI engines do you track?
  A: Eight: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, Perplexity, Kimi, Microsoft Copilot and Google AI Overviews. We track up to 1,000 prompts per brand a day and store every answer with its date.
- Q: How long does GEO take to show results?
  A: It depends on your category, starting point and the sources engines already trust. In one real-estate programme, a residential developer in India moved from a 32% to a 58% visibility score across 8 engines in under 2.5 months. That is one programme, not a promise.
- Q: How much does GEO cost?
  A: It depends on scope: the brands, markets and questions involved. We do not publish prices. Most clients start with a Week-1 baseline, which gives a scorecard, a ranked question universe and a costed plan.
- Q: Do we have to sign a long contract?
  A: No. There are three ways to start: a baseline and universe map; owning your strongest questions first; or a one-quarter pilot with both scoreboards reported monthly and a clear go or stop at month 3.
- Q: Do you guarantee rankings in ChatGPT or Google?
  A: No. The engines decide what they say, and anyone who guarantees rankings is guessing. We do the work rigorously, measure from a Week-1 baseline and show every week what moved.
- Q: How do you measure and report results?
  A: We take a Week-1 baseline, log every fix with its date and re-measure after it is published and crawled. Weekly reports compare against the baseline on two scoreboards: the AI answers, and SEO plus owned enquiries.
- Q: Do you name your clients or show testimonials?
  A: No. We never name, describe identifiably, count or quote clients, and we show no logos or testimonials. Our case studies describe the sector and the market only.
- Q: Do you post on Reddit or edit Wikipedia for clients?
  A: On Reddit and Quora we post openly as the brand, never through fake accounts. On Wikipedia we only propose factual corrections on talk pages, with sources, and never make promotional edits.
- Q: Do you write fake reviews?
  A: Never. We help brands earn a steady stream of real reviews and reply to every one in public. No fabricated reviews, figures or astroturfing.
- Q: How do you handle compliance in India?
  A: Brand, legal and regulatory sign-off comes before anything goes live. We check against RERA, ASCI and SEBI rules where they apply, and our work is aligned with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP).
- Q: Can you help a listed company with what AI tells investors?
  A: Yes, through our Investor Relations package. We keep AI answers accurate and current using only public disclosures, follow SEBI rules and get company sign-off before anything is published. Accuracy, not spin.
- Q: Are you an agency or a software tool?
  A: We are an agency that runs on our own platform, Optimizer GEO. The platform tracks the engines, answers and sources; our six specialist teams ship the fixes and own the KPIs.
- Q: Which industries do you work in?
  A: Nine: real estate and hospitality; financial services and investor relations; retail and consumer brands; food and FMCG; B2B and professional services; technology and SaaS; pharma and healthcare; manufacturing; industrial and engineering; cinema and entertainment.
- Q: Which countries do you work in?
  A: Our home market is India. We also work in the United States and Mauritius.
- Q: What do we get in the first week?
  A: A Week-1 baseline: a readiness scorecard across 8 factors, a ranked universe of the questions your buyers ask, and a costed plan. It is the line every later result is measured against.
- Q: How do we get started?
  A: Email abhay@optimizer360.ai or request an AI audit on our contact page. It shows which engines name you, who they name instead, the sources they cite and the first fixes we would make.
